Cauldron, the GPUI app, for Windows and Mac. Both builds are unsigned.

- **Windows:** download `Cauldron.exe` and run it. Nothing to install. SmartScreen warns the first time: choose More info, then Run anyway.
- **Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel):** download `Cauldron-mac.dmg` and drag Cauldron to Applications. The first time, right-click Cauldron.app and choose Open, or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Cauldron.app`.

The old Tauri app (Backspace) is archived on branch `archive/tauri-app`. Its Windows build stays on the `windows-tauri` release.
